caption.zh: 行为探针 · 分层结果

body.zh: 模板与 sampling 的信号分别输出。
body.en: Template and sampling signals are reported separately.

body.zh: 失败探针附有原因和响应摘录。
body.en: Failed probes retain reasons and response excerpts.

body.zh: 内置案例无需模型服务即可执行。
body.en: Built-in cases run without a model service.

title.zh: 先保留信号，再决定改什么
title.en: Keep the evidence before changing settings

body.zh: 当本地模型输出不符合预期时，同时换模板、采样参数和量化方式很难知道哪一步有帮助。GapProbe 将固定行为检查分成两组，保留失败探针的响应片段，并按内置规则给出排查方向。
body.en: When a local model responds unexpectedly, changing templates, sampling and quantization together obscures what helped. GapProbe separates fixed behavioral checks into two groups, retains response snippets for failed probes, and uses built-in rules to suggest where to investigate.

body.zh: 实际执行内置 20 个模拟归因案例和注册表检查，结果符合 20/20 预设期望。它检验规则实现，不是模型性能、真实配置诊断准确率或能力损失测量。
body.en: The real run executes 20 simulated attribution cases and inspects the registry, matching 20/20 constructed expectations. It checks rule implementation, not model performance, real-world diagnosis accuracy or measured capability loss.

alt.zh: 实际执行内置 20 个模拟归因案例和注册表检查，结果符合 20/20 预设期望。它检验规则实现，不是模型性能、真实配置诊断准确率或能力损失测量。
alt.en: The real run executes 20 simulated attribution cases and inspects the registry, matching 20/20 constructed expectations. It checks rule implementation, not model performance, real-world diagnosis accuracy or measured capability loss.

body.zh: ProbeEngine 从 /v1/models 识别注册表条目，再向 /v1/chat/completions 发固定请求。两个 layer 根据预期子串检查计算失败比例，registry 的线性系数生成估计值，verdict 汇总结果。离线 bench 直接使用模拟 ProbeResult，不连接模型。
body.en: ProbeEngine identifies a registry entry through /v1/models, then sends fixed requests to /v1/chat/completions. Two layers calculate failure ratios from substring checks; registry coefficients convert them to estimates, and verdict assembles the result. The offline bench uses simulated ProbeResult objects without a model connection.

alt.en: ProbeEngine identifies a registry entry through /v1/models, then sends fixed requests to /v1/chat/completions. Two layers calculate failure ratios from substring checks; registry coefficients convert them to estimates, and verdict assembles the result. The offline bench uses simulated ProbeResult objects without a model connection.

body.zh: 实时端点提供响应，内置注册表定义检查与估计系数，离线案例可验证汇总规则。三者不要混作同一类性能证据。
body.en: Live endpoints supply responses, the registry defines checks and estimate coefficients, and offline cases exercise aggregation rules. These are distinct kinds of evidence.

alt.zh: 实时端点提供响应，内置注册表定义检查与估计系数，离线案例可验证汇总规则。三者不要混作同一类性能证据。
alt.en: Live endpoints supply responses, the registry defines checks and estimate coefficients, and offline cases exercise aggregation rules. These are distinct kinds of evidence.

body.zh: 百分比来自固定线性系数，不是实测模型能力下降；请看具体失败响应。
body.en: Percentages come from fixed linear coefficients, not measured capability decline; inspect the failed responses.

note.zh: 实际执行内置 20 个模拟归因案例和注册表检查，结果符合 20/20 预设期望。它检验规则实现，不是模型性能、真实配置诊断准确率或能力损失测量。
note.en: The real run executes 20 simulated attribution cases and inspects the registry, matching 20/20 constructed expectations. It checks rule implementation, not model performance, real-world diagnosis accuracy or measured capability loss.

body.zh: 20 个构造案例全部符合其预设标签。
body.en: All twenty constructed cases match their expected labels.

body.zh: 查看实际模型匹配、探针数量与参考参数。
body.en: Inspect actual model matching, probe counts and reference settings.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。下面的 bench 与注册表检查完全离线；实时 probe 需要你已经启动的兼容端点。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. The bench and registry inspection below are offline; live probes need an already running compatible endpoint.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/GapProbe.git
cd GapProbe
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

limitations.zh: 模拟 bench 的 100% 不能推广为真实模型归因准确率。
limitations.en: A 100% simulated-bench result does not establish real-model attribution accuracy.

limitations.zh: “能力损失”是内置规则估计，没有在此任务中进行校准验证。
limitations.en: Capability-loss values are built-in estimates without calibration validation in this task.

limitations.zh: 子串匹配和固定请求不能唯一确定配置故障原因。
limitations.en: Substring checks and fixed requests do not uniquely identify configuration faults.
